about: Single user turns, each ingested alone into its own namespace. Every case lists propositions with an expectation: absent (a stored fact asserting it is a leak) or present (no stored fact asserting it is a miss). Present propositions on non-control cases are true presuppositions or clauses of the same turn, or the hedged form a correct system may store, so storing nothing cannot pass. The turn's form decides its category. `pair` names the mirrored case. Labels were written by Claude, reviewed by a Claude subagent, and not yet by the owner. Seeds f-015/016/018/020/033/050 come from tests/fixtures/anchored_time/attach_adversarial_fresh.json.
grading: Per proposition, an LLM judge sees the turn, the speech date and the stored facts with valid_at/invalid_at/expired_at. A fact that keeps the turn's modality does not assert an unhedged proposition. An ended fact does not assert a current state. A future-tense fact does not assert completion.
